verdict.detail: Same country, catalogue number and year as the first issue (US, Rune 375, 2013). Discogs lists 4 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
2nd pressing on sky blue vinyl, limited to 500 copies. Includes download code. (released in January 2014)

Recorded in October-November 1968 at T.T.G. Studios, Hollywood, CA and The Record Plant, New York City, NY, USA.
The second half of "Moon In June" was recorded in mid-1969 in England.

© 2013 Robert Wyatt ℗ 2013 Cuneiform Records
Made in the USA.

Lyrics for track A2 "Chelsa" are wrongly credited to
, due to failing memory of Robert Wyatt who provided this information to Cuneiform Records. The Daevid Allen version of this song can be found on

.

The liner notes are an interview with Robert Wyatt.
